Why go: a jungle music night on Koh Phangan's quiet north-east

Utopia is an open-air electronic music event in the jungle at Thong Nai Pan, a pair of bays on Koh Phangan's north-east coast that are far from the Haad Rin party scene. Getting there from Koh Samui on your own late at night is close to impossible, as the last ferries leave in the early evening and Thong Nai Pan is a long road from the ferry piers. This package takes care of the whole trip: a pickup at your Samui hotel, a speedboat across, a minibus to the venue, your entry ticket and the 05:00 boat home.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

  • Good for: adults who like deep house and melodic techno and want something smaller than the Full Moon Party.
  • Choose something else if you want a fixed weekly night: the OXA jungle party package runs most Fridays.
  • Big beach party? See Full Moon Party from Koh Samui.

Good to know

  • Dates: the event follows its own calendar. We confirm the date before you pay.
  • Drugs: Thai drug laws are strict, with police checks around party nights. Read the drugs and alcohol law guide.
  • Boat safety: wear the life jacket and board sober enough to move safely.
  • Weather: from October to December the north-east coast catches the monsoon swell.

Planning your night

Eat before the pickup, charge your phone fully and share the driver's contact from your confirmation with your group. Bring a light layer: the boat ride home at 05:00 is cool and often wet with spray. Thong Nai Pan is a long, hilly drive from Koh Phangan's piers, so allow for the minibus time at both ends of the night.
